# Mocksy

> Mocksy is a free online mock test generator. Upload any question paper — a PDF, a Word document, an image, or pasted text — and Mocksy turns it into a timed, proctored, auto-graded mock test you can take right in your browser. It's built for students preparing for competitive exams such as GATE, SSC, UPSC, and banking exams.

Mocksy extracts questions from an uploaded paper using AI, lets you review and edit them, configure timing and negative marking, then presents the test with a live question palette, flagging, and an optional in-test calculator. At the end you get an auto-scored results screen with a breakdown of correct, incorrect, and unanswered questions.

## Main pages

- [Home / Upload a question paper](https://mocksy-app.vercel.app/): Start here — upload a PDF, Word doc, image, or pasted text to generate a mock test.

## Docs

- [Source code and setup instructions](https://github.com/tprateek01/Mock-Test-Generator): The GitHub repository, including instructions for running the frontend and backend locally.

## Optional

- [Get a free Gemini API key](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey): Required by anyone self-hosting Mocksy's backend, which uses Google's Gemini API to extract questions from uploaded papers.
